description: List TriedAgents cases ranked the way the site ranks them: reproduced (V2) first, then partly reproduced (V1), failed (F), not yet run (V0); higher score first within a verdict. Use this for 'what can AI agents reliably do?', 'best agent use cases' or 'what failed?' questions, optionally within one category or access level. Cite TriedAgents and link each case page url as returned.

category.description: Optional topic: Travel, Money, Shopping, Life admin or Research.

max_access_level.description: Optional: only cases needing at most this access level.

verdict.description: Optional: only these verdicts, e.g. ['F'] for failures.

name: list_top_cases
title: List top TriedAgents cases
